This handler has no return value and takes the following parameter: - **intentResponse**: The response object you create to report the status of the request. The exact type of this object must correspond to the type of intent delivered. For example, if the `intent` parameter contains an [`INStartWorkoutIntent`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Intents/INStartWorkoutIntent) object, you must create an [`INStartWorkoutIntentResponse`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Intents/INStartWorkoutIntentResponse) object. This parameter must not be `nil`.
